sources.method: shallow git clone, README.md + requirements.txt + FL2VA/Ref2VA trees + skills/h3-prompt-writing read locally
verified: two checkpoints FL2VA and Ref2VA, both self-contained diffusers-style repos
H3-Context-IR and H3-Regenerate-2K are not open-sourced (README)
33B dense single-stream Omni-Transformer, ~13B in AdaLN branches; Qwen3-VL-32B encoder layer 50; f16t4d24 visual VAE; 40 Hz audio VAE
output 4-15 s, 24 fps, 32 kHz stereo, shorter side 768 by default
recommended frameworks: SGLang, vLLM, diffusers (minimax-h3 branch), ComfyUI
SGLang serve flags incl. --num-gpus 4 --ulysses-degree 4 --model-variant fl2va|ref2va
prompt structure: integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music; Ref2VA six-section format; <d> dialogue tag; shot + camera grammar
POST /v2/video_generation, Bearer auth
models MiniMax-H3 / Highspeed / Lite / Max with per-model resolutions and durations
content[] types text, image_url, video_url, audio_url with roles first_frame/last_frame/reference_image/reference_video/reference_audio
image-to-video and reference-to-video are mutually exclusive
t2va ratio required and not adaptive; i2va ratio forced adaptive
media limits: body <=64 MB, image <=30 MB side 256-5760, <=9 reference images, <=3 videos <=50 MB 2-15 s each total <=15 s, <=3 audio <=15 MB 2-15 s each total <=15 s
GET /v2/query/video_generation/{task_id}
task.status values incl. succeeded/failed/cancelled
task.content.url holds the mp4; usage carries output_seconds/input_image_count/input_audio_seconds
regeneration 768P->2K $0.05/s
reference audio free, first 5 images free then $0.04, reference video billed at output rate
secondary: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/pricing/overview adds Highspeed $0.06 and Lite $0.04 per second

verified: 4xH100 BF16 SGLang: 50-66 GB per GPU, ~13 s for a 5 s 1344x768 clip
2xRTX 5090 TP2 + layerwise offload: 26.3 GB per GPU, ~560 s
pruned INT8 / NVFP4 community repacks ~31-42 GB, runnable on 16-24 GB cards
full BF16 checkpoint ~124-144 GB
sources.note: community-reported; treat as ranges, not guarantees

verified: H3 API has no free clip allowance: the 'free tier' is a rate limit (2 concurrent tasks on V2, 5 req/min legacy)
Hailuo free plan is a one-time trial (welcome credits, ~150-200, expire in 3 days, watermark, no commercial use); promo: 3 free H3 trials + 3000 credits for installing MiniMax Design
fal offers 5 free H3-Max generations/day as a promotion
Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B-Diffusers is Apache-2.0, ~8.19 GB VRAM, 480p, 81 frames @16 fps; diffusers WanPipeline call signature (height/width/num_frames/guidance_scale) and export_to_video
Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B peaks ~22 GB fp16, needs fp8/offload for 16 GB
sources.note: T4 = Turing sm_75: no bf16, no fp8/NVFP4 -> fp16 + cpu offload + vae tiling

verified: LatentSync 1.5 inference minimum 8 GB VRAM; 1.6 minimum 18 GB (upstream README)
LatentSync code Apache-2.0, weights OpenRAIL++ — commercial use with restrictions
T4 runs LatentSync in fp32 because upstream checks compute capability > 7 (Turing is 7.5); community patch >= 7 enables fp16 ~12.2 GB
Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B: Apache-2.0, 720p 24 fps, ~8 GB fp8/offload to ~22-24 GB fp16
HunyuanVideo 1.5: 8.3B, Tencent community licence, ~14 GB with offload / ~24 GB fp16, ~75 s distilled on RTX 4090, 720p
LTX-2.5: 22B + 12B text encoder, native audio, up to 4K 50 fps, ~32 GB fp8 / 16 GB NVFP4 (Blackwell), LTX-2 Community licence free under 10M USD ARR
Wan 2.2 A14B MoE: 16 GB GGUF+offload, 80 GB official fp16, no native audio
MuseTalk fits 16 GB-class for lipsync; LivePortrait is a light portrait animator
sources.note: VRAM/speed figures are vendor + community ranges captured Oct 2026; none were re-measured in this sandbox (no GPU)
